text_block_list.text:
Heh. First-rate Umamusume must also be
skilled
at gauging their opponent's
strength.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: First place in this race is definitely going to that Umamusume, number three...
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
What a finish! But it's too close to call!
Was it
number one or number three?!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Number three, as I said. Now back
to
traini—
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
The results are in! First place goes to
number one!
The front runner managed
to keep her lead the
whole race!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
Heheh, right on the money again! If you
want
first-rate predictions, look no
further than yours
truly!
text_block_list.name: Shrewd Tipster

text_block_list.text:
That's so amazing! You always know
who's going
to come in first!
text_block_list.name: Tipster's Friend

text_block_list.text:
Hmph, that was merely a coincidence.
My
predictions are certainly more
first-rate than—
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: I won't give up until I win!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Кинг Хало is so absorbed in predicting
races that
she's forgotten about
training...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
